channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of interesting tech opinions and blog posts.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: Separable
item.description: We used to impute a creator behind every painting, text, and proof; now that AI separates the work from the worker, the real question is what a solution without insight is worth — and why labs would rather we not dwell on it.

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: OpenAI Updates Its Model Spec
item.description: OpenAI rewrote the constitution for its models around five core values; Zvi works through the diff — corrigibility, sycophancy, budgets as limits — and finds the examples, not the values, are the weak point.

item.title: SemiAnalysis: GDPx — Measuring Frontier Model Capabilities Across the Most Valuable Domains
item.description: A new agentic benchmark across 11 high-value domains where the best model scores just 12% — and finance and legal come back at exactly zero for everyone.

item.title: Colsto: I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location (and it's everywhere)
item.description: Background aircraft noise in a video soundtrack, matched against ADS-B data via Doppler curves, can pin a recording's location to ~100m — even from under a minute of audio.
